name: Hawaii Steel LLC
old_description: Hawaii Steel is the go-to source for structural steel construction in Hawaii. Our team of experienced professionals specializes in commercial and industrial projects, using the latest in state-of-the-art equipment and technology to ensure the highest quality of work.
about:
Hawaii Steel LLC operates from Kapolei on the island of Oahu, Hawaii. The company provides structural steel fabrication and erection services across the Hawaiian Islands.

Its core services include structural steel construction, welding, pre-engineered metal building assembly, fabrication, design-build, and miscellaneous metals contracting. The firm uses modern equipment to handle commercial and industrial projects of varying scale.

Hawaii Steel works primarily with general contractors on projects such as the BYU Hawaii Math & Science Building, Solomon Elementary School, East Kapolei Elementary School, Safeway at Ho‘okele Shopping Center, Turtle Bay Resort exterior renovations, JFC Hawaii Warehouse, Diamond Head Theater, and BYU Hawaii Hale 11-13 housing. These projects span education, retail, hospitality, warehouse, and entertainment sectors.

The company emphasizes on-time, on-budget delivery and adherence to high quality standards, backed by its American Institute of Steel Construction (AISC) certification (C-00025171). It states that its commitment to quality and customer satisfaction drives its approach to complex steel projects.
